entities.name: Sulayman ibn Mihran al-A’mash
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Muhammad Sulayman ibn Mihran al-Asadi al-Kahili also known as al-Aʽmash (الأعمش) was a Muslim scholar of the generation of Tabi'un. He was a notable muhaddith and qāriʾ. Due to his poor eyesight, people used to call him al-Aʽmash.
